weapons.name: Covenant Pistol
source_cells: **1. Covenant Pistol** · sidearm / Ledger Slugs
Squared blackened-steel revolver with a cathedral-door cylinder, red wax seal beside the hammer and a short ivory grip scratched with tiny signatures; tall angular muzzle flash
Accurate reliable opening weapon; alt-fire marks an enemy's weak point, increasing follow-up ammo recovery
Issued to Last Office clerks so that an execution could be described as contract enforcement; guaranteed initial firearm

provisional_stats.name: Covenant Pistol
provisional_stats.notes: starter / Last Office; mark weak point +10% next hit; valid on counters

weapons.name: Coil Shotgun
source_cells: **2. Coil Shotgun** · heavy / Coil Shells
Twin copper rails clamped around a sawed-off iron barrel, huge cream ceramic insulator, hand-operated sliding breech, dangling blue diagnostic cable
Devastating close cone; perfect-timing pump fires a narrow penetrator blast; high stagger, slow reload
Salvaged from storm shutters after the White Quiet; first found in checkpoints or Sootworks

provisional_stats.name: Coil Shotgun
provisional_stats.notes: checkpoints / foundry; 8 pellets × 8, precise pump on timed input

weapons.name: Nail Storm
source_cells: **3. Nail Storm** · heavy / Rivet Belts
Boxy riveter with four offset square barrels, spinning orange belt-drum, exposed piston rod and a safety label that has been scratched away
Sustained automatic suppression; builds heat; can pin small enemies to walls and recover ammo from shattered armour
The Brass Union designed it to build housing, then used it to dismantle its masters; Sootworks stock

weapons.name: Saw Lance
source_cells: **4. Saw Lance** · melee / pressure charge
Telescoping iron mining pole with **two reciprocating, opposed shear jaws**, a black pressure clutch and flattened toothed plates; no rotating chain
Reach-melee combo, grapple-hook finisher, overheat and bleeding; recovers Breath on staggered targets
The first miners cut the Engine's foundation with these; common foundry find

provisional_stats.name: Saw Lance
provisional_stats.notes: foundry; normal slash free, charged jaw press 1 pressure cartridge

weapons.name: Volt Rifle
source_cells: **5. Volt Rifle** · rifle / Voltaic Cells
Lengthy olive-painted carbine with paired glass vacuum tubes, two buzzing copper electrodes and a folding triangular stock; electric arcs flash between prongs
Mid-range precision burst; alt-fire chains through electrical enemies; interrupts machinery
Developed to restrain malfunctioning memory pumps without destroying expensive labour; barracks technicians

provisional_stats.name: Volt Rifle
provisional_stats.notes: Barracks; alt fire chains through connected live machinery for +1 cell

weapons.name: Bone Mortar
source_cells: **6. Bone Mortar** · launcher / Ossuary Pods
Compact industrial ceramic compression drum, sealed rectangular waste-ejector muzzle and a pair of padded bracing handles; biomaterial remains sealed inside the numbered pods
Slow explosive arcing shots; leaves fragments that deny territory; strong vs clustered hordes
Crafted from biomaterial reclaimed by the city's corpse recyclers; black-market dealer or rare boss

provisional_stats.name: Bone Mortar
provisional_stats.notes: recycler / rare boss; blast radius 3.0m, hurt allied apparatus

weapons.name: Censer Flamer
source_cells: **7. Censer Flamer** · heavy / Censer Fuel
Incense burner fixed beneath a vented iron nozzle, three punctured brass fuel canisters, tarnished silver devotional plates and a blue-orange pilot flame
Short-range cone, persistent Ember floor hazards; exposes stealth Echoforms, but risks burning evidence
Priests once used cleansing smoke to conceal the smell of memory harvesting; Basilica cache

provisional_stats.name: Censer Flamer
provisional_stats.notes: Basilica; a 0.1 s pulse spends 1 fuel, floor hazard 2s

weapons.name: Harpoon Injector
source_cells: **8. Harpoon Injector** · rifle / Harpoon Spurs
Pneumatic industrial spear gun with thick white medical syringes in a rotating chamber, teal glass pressure gauge, twin hooks around the muzzle
Pierces armour, pins mobile targets; alternate shot pulls loose objects or extracts an enemy's temporary buff
Designed for tranquilising and relocating dangerous printed organisms; Orchard surgical annex

provisional_stats.name: Harpoon Injector
provisional_stats.notes: Orchard; pulls unanchored objects; elite foes resist pull

weapons.name: Hush Carbine
source_cells: **9. Hush Carbine** · rifle / Waking Tape
Compact black SMG whose side-fed cassette spools under an amber window, padded barrel shroud and little tuning-fork sights
Fast low-flash sonic projectiles; disrupts Choir shields and Echoform commands; relatively low raw damage
Secret Last Office crowd-control weapon using stolen lullabies as ammunition; restricted kiosk

provisional_stats.name: Hush Carbine
provisional_stats.notes: Last Office; quiet fire, interrupts sonic shields

weapons.name: Cinder Launcher
source_cells: **10. Cinder Launcher** · launcher / Cinder Casks
Squat shoulder-thrown furnace tube, triangular iron cage around the exhaust, red-painted release latch and scorched canvas wrap; glaring oval hot core
Area firebomb, chargeable cluster shot; destroys organic growth but damages neutral objects if careless
Emergency burn-off device converted into riot artillery; Sootworks and fallen siege crews

provisional_stats.name: Cinder Launcher
provisional_stats.notes: Sootworks; radius 3.5m, burns stored evidence if hit

weapons.name: Widow's Toll
source_cells: **11. Widow's Toll** · rare sidearm / Waking Tape
An elderly bronze handbell split lengthwise and mounted on a black pistol grip; a small porcelain shoe hangs from the trigger guard; barrel is a dark open throat
High sonic stagger and grief-mark debuff; forced captures suffer loyalty strain nearby
Iona's altered mourning bell, obtained by coercive reunion or exploitation; the ringing sounds briefly like a child calling home

provisional_stats.name: Widow’s Toll
provisional_stats.notes: Iona branch; debuff grief signal for 4s

weapons.name: Surgeon's Mercy
source_cells: **12. Surgeon's Mercy** · rare sidearm / Ledger Slugs
Slender pearl-handled surgical bolt pistol, four tiny crimson capillaries along the slide, silver thumb-rest and clean white steel wedge-shaped sight
Weak-point precision shots convert a fraction of damage into healing for one nearby ally/Echoform; modest damage
Sela's surgically freed hand fitted its trigger; earned by ending her forced treatments

provisional_stats.name: Surgeon’s Mercy
provisional_stats.notes: Sela branch; weak point transfers 20% dealt damage to present ally, cap 12 heal / 4s

weapons.name: Penance Fang
source_cells: **13. Penance Fang** · rare melee / pressure charge
Curved motorised trench blade with chipped olive enamel, broad saw teeth, prison tally marks and Kest's old dog tag wired into the handle
Heavy bleed and an armour-splitting execute; increases faction fear and reduces some nonlethal dialogue modifiers
Built from Kest-07's imposed obedience; gained by wiping his identity or forcing him into servitude

provisional_stats.name: Penance Fang
provisional_stats.notes: Kest branch; bleed 4/s for 4s on charged hit; 1 cartridge

weapons.name: Debt Collector's Smile
source_cells: **14. Debt Collector's Smile** · rare sidearm / Ledger Slugs
Six-chamber dark chrome handgun shaped like a grinning receipt dispenser, white paper ribbon feeding under the barrel and gold tally dots on the grip
Enormous close critical damage; every fifth lethal hit adds corruption that complicates civilian dealings
The Pale Ledger's predatory investment in Ninth's future; gained by signing the cruel prophecy

provisional_stats.name: Debt Collector’s Smile
provisional_stats.notes: Pale Ledger branch; +25% weak-point critical, 5th lethal hit records scandal

weapons.name: Choirbreaker
source_cells: **15. Choirbreaker** · rare rifle / Waking Tape
Boxy cancellation projector with staggered rectangular acoustic waveguides, one fabric-wrapped damping handle and a white pressure index; no ceremonial organ-pipe barrel
Focused Sonic line shot; interrupts sonic bosses and can subdue a distressed Echoform without killing it
Ossa made it by dismantling the forced choir's control bell, obtained through rescue and public exposure

provisional_stats.name: Choirbreaker
provisional_stats.notes: Ossa branch; silence forced choir emitters for 3s

weapons.name: Ferryman's Hook
source_cells: **16. Ferryman's Hook** · rare rifle / Harpoon Spurs
Rust-red harpoon gun with boat-hook bayonet, oilskin-wrapped barrel and six brass ferry fare rings that clatter on every shot
Hooks stunned foes across cover and pulls Ninth towards anchor points; coercive use damages Resolve in dialogue
Perrin's tool converted to an instrument of abduction, gained by selling passengers to the ferry system

provisional_stats.name: Ferryman’s Hook
provisional_stats.notes: Perrin branch; yank only lighter targets or pre-marked rail anchor

weapon_mods.name: Witness Seal
weapon_mods.effect: weak-point mark extends from 3 to 5 s; revealed target is not evidence itself

weapon_mods.name: Exaction Spring
weapon_mods.effect: shot interval 0.42→0.34 s; recoil ×1.22

weapon_mods.name: Crowd Brake
weapon_mods.effect: stagger +35%, spread cone +25%, effective range 9→6 m

weapon_mods.name: Glass Choke
weapon_mods.effect: replace pellet shot with one 56-damage penetrator; range 9→19 m

weapon_mods.name: Chain of Wages
weapon_mods.effect: 20% chance on eligible defeated debt enforcer to return 2 Rivets, max 12/district; Brass Union hostility +1

weapon_mods.name: Cradle Clamp
weapon_mods.effect: while sliding spread ×0.72; swap time +0.12 s

weapon_mods.name: Mercy Brake
weapon_mods.effect: staggered humanoid finisher is nonlethal; Breath restored 18→12

weapon_mods.name: Grinder Crown
weapon_mods.effect: rotating *abrasive collar* outside opposed reciprocating shear jaws; heavy-armour damage ×1.25; heat +5 per charged strike; no chain blade

weapon_mods.name: Blue Testament
weapon_mods.effect: arc chaining to a marked allied machine repairs up to 5 local integrity per district; extra cell cost 1

weapon_mods.name: Fulgur Fork
weapon_mods.effect: chain targets +1, total cell use per alt shot 2→3

weapon_mods.name: Mother's Casket
weapon_mods.effect: blast radius 3.0→2.1 m, heal a protected ally 8 HP if within 2 m (once per 6 s)

weapon_mods.name: Grave Splitter
weapon_mods.effect: add four 7-damage splinters, each affects a target at most once

weapon_mods.name: Saint's Wick
weapon_mods.effect: removes one weak Mnemonic field per 30 fuel spent; sustained direct damage -10%

weapon_mods.name: Penance Vent
weapon_mods.effect: flame range 7→10 m; self-heat accrues +1 per fuel

weapon_mods.name: Mercy Needle
weapon_mods.effect: alt consumes 2 spurs and heals cooperating Echoform 14 strain, no enemy damage

weapon_mods.name: Trawl Barbs
weapon_mods.effect: object pull strength ×1.5, target inflicted scar social consequence when used on civilians

weapon_mods.name: Quiet Hours
weapon_mods.effect: enemy-alert radius ×0.65, stagger ×0.80

weapon_mods.name: Choir Throat
weapon_mods.effect: sonic shield disruption +30%, noise alert radius ×1.50

weapon_mods.name: Heat Bloom
weapon_mods.effect: ignite up to 4 growth tiles for 4 s; collateral risk +1 if civilian fixtures hit

weapon_mods.name: Salvage Cage
weapon_mods.effect: radius 3.5→2.4 m, 6 fragments ×8 damage, one hit/target

ammunition.name: Ledger Slugs
source_cells: **Ledger Slugs**
Stubby black brass cartridges with a white signature strip around each base; pre-war clerks stamped legal approvals onto bullet casings; sidearms use them.

ammunition.name: Coil Shells
source_cells: **Coil Shells**
Fat ivory ceramic shells with twin copper contact rails; storm-worker charges now power shotgun bursts.

ammunition.name: Rivet Belts
source_cells: **Rivet Belts**
Heavy linked strips of rust-red industrial nails with the old Brass Union crest stamped on the links; automatic Nail Storm feed.

ammunition.name: Pressure Cartridges
source_cells: **Pressure Cartridges**
Pale brass aerosol cylinders with a red pressure needle; used to recharge Saw Lance/Penance Fang motor assistance; basic slashes still work at zero charge.

ammunition.name: Voltaic Cells
source_cells: **Voltaic Cells**
Blue-green translucent batteries inside black steel finger cages, warm to the touch and faintly singing; Volt Rifle power source.

ammunition.name: Ossuary Pods
source_cells: **Ossuary Pods**
White egg-shaped bone capsules, wax-sealed and numbered on black labels; the city's recycled remains now become Bone Mortar projectiles.

ammunition.name: Censer Fuel
source_cells: **Censer Fuel**
Narrow copper flasks with a burning orange wick on their label; formerly sanctified disinfectant, now flamer ammunition.

ammunition.name: Harpoon Spurs
source_cells: **Harpoon Spurs**
Silver darts in a three-tine hinged rack, with long green thread trailing from each tip; supplied to the Injector and Ferryman's Hook.

ammunition.name: Waking Tape
source_cells: **Waking Tape**
Tiny black cassette coils with cream paper labels listing unknown children's names; recorded memory patterns become Sonic projectiles.

ammunition.name: Cinder Casks
source_cells: **Cinder Casks**
Miniature thick-walled red cylinders capped with a conical steel fuse; furnace residue burns fiercely when shattered by the launcher.

armour_sets.name: Hearthkeeper Rags
source_cells: **1. Hearthkeeper Rags** · shelter volunteers
**Filter Hood:** oatmeal canvas cowl with two yellowed breathing discs and blue stitched initials
**Refuge Smock:** thick off-white quilted torso with red stitch repairs, small copper air gauge and rib straps
**Shelter Boots:** black rubber industrial boots with extra patched knees and a dangling air hose
More Breath from medical pickups; low armour; the first piece of clothing Ninth remembers wearing

armour_sets.name: Brass Union Rig
source_cells: **2. Brass Union Rig** · foundry workers
**Welder Brow:** square soot-dark iron brow guard with green observation slit and a melted crest
**Rivet Harness:** wide yellow-brown leather suspenders over copper-reinforced breastplate, a hammer loop at the hip
**Furnace Chaps:** overlapping black heat plates on knees and shins, red canvas tied around ankles
Heat resistance; bonus stagger while sliding; every patch was sewn after a strike or strikebreaking raid

armour_sets.name: Broker's Mourning Suit
source_cells: **3. Broker's Mourning Suit** · Ashmarket enforcers
**Receipt Visor:** narrow black silk veil pinned across a silver counting-eye
**Mourner's Coat:** tailored charcoal coat with pale contract slips sewn like scales inside the lapels
**Auction Gaiters:** tall burgundy leather boots with little price tags attached at the rear heel
Discounts from compliant traders, reduced tolerance from rescued citizens; designed to make collection look ceremonial

armour_sets.name: Last Lamp Vestments
source_cells: **4. Last Lamp Vestments** · Basilica guards
**Censer Halo:** bent copper ring above a padded white skull cap, ash-black holes from earlier bolts
**Reliquary Cuirass:** tarnished gold chest plates over bottle-green choir cloth, a pair of open speaker grilles at ribs
**Drowned Slacks:** dark sea-green leggings wrapped in silver pipe insulation, rust stains at cuffs
Resistance to Sonic status and shallow-water slowdown; built from decommissioned hymn machinery

armour_sets.name: Glass Pruner Coat
source_cells: **5. Glass Pruner Coat** · Orchard researchers
**Lens Wreath:** interlocking triangular glass lenses in a rubber cap, one lens opaque violet
**Pruner Mantle:** faded olive surgeon's coat over a translucent ribbed resin vest, blue resin spills at seams
**Glass Treads:** broad rubber boots lined with pearl scales, triangular cleats inset into soles
Less Puncture from glass shards and higher Insight when examining plant evidence; designed to survive living conservatories

armour_sets.name: Last Office Plate
source_cells: **6. Last Office Plate** · military police
**White Enamel Helm:** large bucket-shaped ivory helmet with black rectangular mouth slot and asymmetrical red tally marks
**Order Breastplate:** green ceramic slabs riveted to dark ballistic cloth, shoulder badge stamped with a scratched-out name
**Checkpoint Greaves:** high matte-black shin braces with deep red boot straps, worn square toes
Better heavy-weapon stability and Impact defence; reduces citizen trust when entering settlements armed

armour_sets.name: Reprint Shroud
source_cells: **7. Reprint Shroud** · failed printed bodies
**Null Mask:** smooth smoke-grey faceplate with one round lens and a vertical white seam down the centre
**Seam Mantle:** long torn grey drape threaded with violet surgical sutures, sections of internal framework exposed
**Blank Feet:** pale brace-legged walking apparatus with black stitch marks and mismatched heel heights
Faster recovery from Mnemonic status, lower max physical armour; recovered from bodies the machine discarded

armour_sets.name: Architect's Burden
source_cells: **8. Architect's Burden** · Engine core engineers
**Measure Crown:** brass caliper-shaped frame arching above the head, six small numbered lenses, black cloth veil behind
**Charter Carapace:** heavy brown leather and white enamel breastpiece, filled with brass rulers, legal seals and thin cables
**Foundation Boots:** squat iron-toed shoes with carved centimetre markings and grease-black gaiters
Adds a Tech contextual dialogue option and reduces damage from traps; its seams conceal the architect's original confession

unique_armour.name: Recall Plate
source_cells: **Recall Plate** · full set overlay / Kest's good ending

Olive-and-ivory armour visibly engraved with the names of recovered soldiers across helmet, chest and greaves; moderate protection and one nonlethal stand-down command per barracks visit; Kest refuses to have the names polished away. Occupies three armour slots.

unique_armour.name: Salt Pilgrim Greaves
source_cells: **Salt Pilgrim Greaves** · legs / Perrin's self-sacrifice route

White-salt-crusted thigh-high oilskin waders, cracked black boots and seven little ferry tickets folded into the seams; remove water slowdown and cause the boots to leave bright wet footprints in dark corridors.

unique_armour.name: Salt-Sewn Hood
source_cells: **Salt-Sewn Hood** · head / Ossa's ruined outcome

Dark grey funeral hood with sea-salt crystals along the face opening and a brass bell clapper instead of a throat clasp; reveals distant ghost-whisper hints but imposes -1 Speech while worn because the living recoil from it.

common_relics.name: Copper Witness
source_cells: **Copper Witness**
Coin-sized oval mirror under brown tarnish, in which a person's reflection arrives half a second late; made for inspectors of memory loss
Reveals forged witness statements and fake door signs in some areas

common_relics.name: Red Thread Spool
source_cells: **Red Thread Spool**
Tiny pewter spool wound with crimson thread and one black knot; burial seamstress tradition
Slightly improves companion rescue speed and reveals a trail left by missing NPCs

common_relics.name: Cinder Rosary
source_cells: **Cinder Rosary**
Seven coarse charcoal beads on copper wire, one bead always smouldering; worn by air-filter workers
Minor Ember resistance and better salvage chance from furnace kills

common_relics.name: Blank Signet
source_cells: **Blank Signet**
Thin silver ring with an empty square seal and a sharp interior edge; an administrator's attempt to erase rank
Better anonymity at Last Office checks; mild merchant suspicion in Ashmarket

common_relics.name: Glass Psalm
source_cells: **Glass Psalm**
Triangular blue glass flake suspended in a wire cage; piece of the first false sun
Amplifies Echoform Glass attacks slightly, increases Sonic vulnerability

common_relics.name: Rivet Psalm
source_cells: **Rivet Psalm**
Steel union token shaped like three interlocking nails, punched through the centre
Small Force boost on heavy equipment interactions; miners recognise it

common_relics.name: Dead Battery
source_cells: **Dead Battery**
Obsolete square cell with red and yellow poles bound by cloth; known to work only when nobody watches
One automatic temporary ward after lethal Arc damage, then recharges between districts

common_relics.name: Hearth Photo
source_cells: **Hearth Photo**
Small sepia picture under cloudy celluloid showing a family with the faces rubbed away
Reduces NPC fear if Ninth arrives unarmed; provides no combat bonus

common_relics.name: Moth Glass
source_cells: **Moth Glass**
Curved bronze lens containing a preserved translucent moth wing
Briefly reveals hidden Echoforms and secret nursery passages

common_relics.name: Bone Tally
source_cells: **Bone Tally**
Five ivory counters on a black loop, each with a different death date
Increases recovery after a close-range finisher, small susceptibility to Mnemonic attacks

common_relics.name: Chorus Plug
source_cells: **Chorus Plug**
Copper ear insert with a cross-cut black rubber seal and blue identification bead
Resists Dissonance but reduces distance of sound-based secret clues

common_relics.name: Train Nail
source_cells: **Train Nail**
A bent nickel-steel rail spike wrapped in salt-white twine
Shows the nearest unlocked route toward a rail station, not a main quest shortcut

named_relics_tools.name: Namesake Locket
source_cells: **Namesake Locket** · relic
Oval dirty-gold locket that opens onto two tiny uneven photographs, joined by a single red hair
Nearby lost-identity evidence glows faint amber; obtained by respecting Iona and her daughter's choices

named_relics_tools.name: Broker's Chit
source_cells: **Broker's Chit** · relic
Rectangular bone voucher with clipped corners, black ink signature and a still-wet red price stamp
Improves black-market trades but reduces recruitment trust; Iona exploit path

named_relics_tools.name: Brin's Torque
source_cells: **Brin's Torque** · relic
Thick iron neck-ring split at the hinge, stamped with payroll numbers and repaired by six brass finger-shaped rivets
Improves repairs, unlocks cover-plate crafting if Brin survives; union liberation reward

named_relics_tools.name: Union Rivet Kit
source_cells: **Union Rivet Kit** · utility consumable
Red folded canvas roll containing eight brass rivets and a stubby yellow punch
Reroll two offered gun-mod choices once; negotiated strike outcome

named_relics_tools.name: Black Shift Badge
source_cells: **Black Shift Badge** · relic
Coal-black enamel clock disc, hands welded at 03:17, hanging from a broken chain
Ember resistance, worse lawful merchant prices; recovered from Boiler Penitent Brin

named_relics_tools.name: Reliquary Tag
source_cells: **Reliquary Tag** · relic
Two white enamel soldier ID tags joined back-to-back so neither name can be read
Reveals sealed military maintenance doors; Kest killed path

named_relics_tools.name: Drowned Canticle
source_cells: **Drowned Canticle** · relic
Silver tongue from an enormous bell in a transparent water vial; hums when held near a mouth
Grants an acoustic ward, makes silent faction enforcers suspicious; Ossa exploit path

named_relics_tools.name: White Ledger
source_cells: **White Ledger** · relic
Bright white pocket accounts book with transparent pages and blood-red ruled margins
Stronger direct healing, but healing consumes a small temporary memory reserve; Sela automation path

named_relics_tools.name: Consent Bell
source_cells: **Consent Bell** · field tool
Small bronze handbell lined with violet felt and a silk knot around the handle
Enables voluntary Echoform recruitment dialogue and higher initial loyalty; Venn rescue path

named_relics_tools.name: Cage Clamp
source_cells: **Cage Clamp** · field tool
Heavy black three-prong wrist trap with yellow caution stripes and purple sparking contacts
Immediate forced Echoform binding; lower loyalty and higher chance of refusal; Venn exploit path

named_relics_tools.name: Broken Cocoon
source_cells: **Broken Cocoon** · relic
Dry grey cocoon under green glass, torn open from the inside
Reveals rare Echoform spawn marks, starts recruited creatures with lower morale; Venn abandon path

named_relics_tools.name: Fare Token
source_cells: **Fare Token** · relic
Green oxidised ferry coin, one face showing a boat, the other a child's scratched height mark
Adds one free district travel link and supports evacuation capacity; Perrin repair route

named_relics_tools.name: Unwritten Page
source_cells: **Unwritten Page** · relic
Blank yellowed paper pinned between two pieces of glass, handwriting briefly appears only while turning it
Detects one false objective or deceptive prediction per run; Pale Ledger refused route

named_relics_tools.name: Carbon Key
source_cells: **Carbon Key** · field tool
Flat graphite-black key with duplicating-paper teeth and a small pale receipt spool
Opens one optional archive lock without ammunition or Tech requirement; Pale Ledger tricked route

named_relics_tools.name: Resonance Bell
source_cells: **Resonance Bell** · default field tool
Rusty palm-size brass bell with concentric red enamel rings, pale cotton handle and visible hairline cracks
Guaranteed recruit/negotiation interface for Echoforms, regardless of Venn's presence; slower than Consent Bell but never blocks progression

named_relics_tools.name: Censer Probe
source_cells: **Censer Probe** · common field tool
Blunt steel screwdriver with incense holes along its shaft and a tiny emerald indicator lamp
Tests air filters and disarms one class of pressure traps; available from Hearth Nine

consumables.name: Breath Ampoule
source_cells: **Breath Ampoule**
Pear-shaped cobalt glass vial wrapped in coarse white gauze, containing blue effervescent liquid; condensed fresh air manufactured in Hearth Nine from a failing filter
Restores a moderate amount of Ninth's Breath/health; common, reliably stocked in shelter

consumables.name: Printed Flesh Wrap
source_cells: **Printed Flesh Wrap**
Rectangular salmon-coloured biopaper in a folded medical tin, with fine blue blood-vessel lines; grown from discarded reprint material
Heal over several seconds and remove a light wound; disabled briefly when hit

consumables.name: Triage Vapour
source_cells: **Triage Vapour**
Small rusty inhaler fitted with ivory double nozzles and a green warning stencil; once administered to workers during furnace accidents
Immediate modest healing and brief movement recovery, but increases visual distortion

consumables.name: Graft Soup
source_cells: **Graft Soup**
Sealed dented metal ration can, grey handwritten label and a spoon taped to its side; laboratory leftovers from nutrient-grown replacement organs
Large out-of-combat healing plus temporary increased maximum Breath; mild Mnemonic strain

consumables.name: Sister's Thimble
source_cells: **Sister's Thimble**
Little silver thimble full of dark red resin, lid stamped with a candle; covert medicine shared by Basilica lay sisters
Removes one serious status and grants short Sonic defence; uncommon

consumables.name: Last Ration
source_cells: **Last Ration**
Dry tan biscuit wrapped in an old timetable, tied with red thread, smells of copper and burnt sugar
Small healing and one Resolve boost during the next NPC dialogue; found with refugees

consumables.name: Adrenal Bell
source_cells: **Adrenal Bell**
Thumb-sized copper ampoule with ringing ceramic pellet trapped in its neck; illegal Last Office combat stimulant
Faster sprint and weapon swap for a few seconds, then a temporary stamina deficit

consumables.name: Salt Charge
source_cells: **Salt Charge**
Rough white cylinder bound in black tar paper with a blue wax fuse; engineers used salt explosions to suppress unstable memory fog
Area anti-Husk damage and clears cursed surfaces; low direct damage to humans

consumables.name: Glass Flechette
source_cells: **Glass Flechette**
Cracked crystal orb packed with bright triangular fragments, held by crossed copper wire; harvested from Orchard machinery
Explodes into short-range Puncture shards, effective against lightly armoured clusters

consumables.name: Cinder Bottle
source_cells: **Cinder Bottle**
Thick brown medicine bottle containing orange sludge and a cloth wick, dripped wax sealing the neck; improvised picket weapon
Creates persistent Ember floor hazard; can burn NPC evidence and supplies if careless

consumables.name: Screaming Ribbon
source_cells: **Screaming Ribbon**
Long strip of yellow tape wound round a serrated bone spool, faint black handwritten names along its edge; broadcast waste from the Basilica
Throws a sonic decoy that draws sound-hunting enemies and disrupts weak Choir shields

consumables.name: Discharge Canister
source_cells: **Discharge Canister**
Ribbed cyan-black grenade with two brass screw terminals and a flashing red bead; decommissioned battery failsafe
Short Arc stun against machines, can power an emergency terminal once if thrown carefully

consumables.name: Containment Staple
source_cells: **Containment Staple**
Palm-length black spring-loaded staple gun strip, violet pins tied in three bundles; designed by Last Office creature handlers
One forced capture attempt against a weakened recruitable Echoform, with loyalty penalty and risk of eventual revolt

consumables.name: Echo Feed
source_cells: **Echo Feed**
Sachet of grey granular powder with childlike doodles printed in pale blue; engineered nutrition for memory organisms
Restores a moderate amount of Echoform endurance between duels

consumables.name: Gauze Cocoon
source_cells: **Gauze Cocoon**
Folded cream-coloured fibrous mesh ball with little copper pins around the edges; adopted from surgical emergency shelters
Revives one unravelled Echoform with low endurance after a battle, not during a boss's decisive turn

consumables.name: Reset Resin
source_cells: **Reset Resin**
Teal dropper bottle containing thick translucent fluid, suspended silver particles moving uphill; accidental by-product of reprint chemistry
Clears one Echoform debuff or one temporary move-lock

consumables.name: Truce Wafer
source_cells: **Truce Wafer**
Thin blue square biscuit sealed in transparent film with a hand-shaped sigil; used by early ethical tamers
During a duel offers a single extra non-coercive negotiation attempt, not a guaranteed catch

consumables.name: Imprint Dye
source_cells: **Imprint Dye**
Two tiny conjoined ampoules, one ember-orange, one violet, tied by grey string; illicit Orchard horticulture experiment
Changes one Echoform's cosmetic imprint route within its unlocked legal variants, never overrides consent history

consumables.name: Archive Solvent
source_cells: **Archive Solvent**
Flat green bottle with black-paper-wrapped stopper and red measurement lines; used by clerks to dissolve paper locks
Exposes one hidden archive layer or removes a document seal; alternative Tech check remains possible

consumables.name: False Papers
source_cells: **False Papers**
Creased buff identity folio with faded photograph window, two competing signatures and a fresh crimson stamp
Supports one disguise/deception check; can be detected by high-ranking Last Office staff

consumables.name: Transit Chit
source_cells: **Transit Chit**
Small punched blue card with zigzag silver stripe and oily finger marks; workers' rationed permission to travel
Opens an optional fast-travel gate, does not replace the three Writs

consumables.name: Canal Lamp
source_cells: **Canal Lamp**
Squat yellow paraffin lamp with caged green glass chimney, dripping black handle insulation; found on submerged ferry docks
Reveals reflected signs and submerged path markings for one region; burns out after use

consumables.name: Spare Fuse
source_cells: **Spare Fuse**
White ceramic plug capped with heavy copper tips and handwritten repair date; found in every maintenance shed
Restarts one local power board or trap circuit; allows a resource-driven alternate route

echoforms.name: Cindermoth
source_cells: **Cindermoth** · Ember
Hand-sized black moth enlarged to dog scale, scalloped bronze wings with little eye-like holes, thorax glowing like coal, twelve-frame wingbeat leaving ember pixels
Born from the memory of a child watching the first sunrise; evasive support; found in Orchard ash vents
Ash Wing, Lantern Flicker, Scorch Kiss, Ember Shelter

echoforms.name: Boiler Calf
source_cells: **Boiler Calf** · Ember
Low cattle-like furnace with ivory rib grate, chimney horns exhaling flat grey sprite smoke, piston knees, burning-red eye vents
Printed from the memory of a factory animal that never existed; slow area bruiser; Sootworks boilers
Furnace Kick, Steam Shield, Cinder Charge, Last Whistle

echoforms.name: Rootkin
source_cells: **Rootkin** · Growth
Loping deer-shaped cluster of pale roots with a human hand in place of one antler, luminous moss joints and dripping dark soil
Remembers an impossible childhood garden; healing/binding; Glass Orchard nursery
Root Lash, Quiet Bloom, Pollen Veil, Grasping Floor

echoforms.name: Cradle Wasp
source_cells: **Cradle Wasp** · Growth
Wasp the size of a terrier, striped abdomen made of nursery blankets, six stiff needle legs and gauze wings
Formed from memories of lost childcare; quick debuff/tactical reposition; orphanage annex
Needle Dance, Swaddling Fog, Memory Sap, Cradle Guard

echoforms.name: Mirror Jackal
source_cells: **Mirror Jackal** · Glass
Transparent long-snouted hound with internal silver skeleton and flat triangular facets; its reflection is animated a frame late
Built from a stolen wedding portrait; speed, counterattack and false doubles; Orchard glass tunnels
Shard Bite, Mirror Step, Refraction, Thin Ice

echoforms.name: Prism Eel
source_cells: **Prism Eel** · Glass
Floating eel in a segmented crystal tube, gold teeth visible through glass, tiny coloured light flashes in the ribs
Once a mirror's memory of the sea; piercing special damage; flooded industrial ducts
Prism Bolt, Splinter Current, Clear Skin, Glass Wake

echoforms.name: Spool Hound
source_cells: **Spool Hound** · Wire
Three-legged steel terrier with braided copper body, cassette-reel flanks and a sparking antenna tail
Leaks recorded guard-dog commands; anti-Choir disruptor; barracks transmitter rooms
Current Fang, Static Bark, Cable Snare, Overwind

echoforms.name: Suture Mite
source_cells: **Suture Mite** · Wire
Beetle-bodied surgical stapler, spindly chrome limbs, a row of fine red-lit sutures down its shell
Reprints last words as electrical pulses; utility and defensive debuff; hospital train
Staple Bite, Patch Circuit, Electrode Flare, False Pulse

echoforms.name: Bell Wretch
source_cells: **Bell Wretch** · Choir
Pale frog-like body with swollen bell-shaped throat, tuning forks growing through shoulders, throat inflates before sonic attack
A hymn remembered after the singers died; ranged control; Flood Basilica
Chime Crush, Dissonant Note, Choir Shield, Toll of Three

echoforms.name: Hush Heron
source_cells: **Hush Heron** · Choir
Tall, skinless bird with porcelain mask-face, tubular throat, black lace flight feathers and tiny red foot-bells
Recalls moments of silence before executions; precise disabling attacks; drowned crypt
Silence Spear, Unsaid Verse, Wing of Mercy, Requiem

echoforms.name: Name Leech
source_cells: **Name Leech** · Husk
Fleshy grey slug with human handwriting across translucent skin, short grasping teeth, a little receipt dangling from its jaw
Consumes titles and labels; durable attrition; Ashmarket archive drains
Unname, Memory Siphon, Husk Coil, Borrowed Skin

echoforms.name: Grief Stag
source_cells: **Grief Stag** · Husk
Broad-shouldered skeletal elk clad in moth-eaten overcoat cloth, candles in antlers, jaw opens sideways in three frames
A family's collective memory of someone nobody can identify; terminal boss-capable tank; abandoned rail
Grief Horn, Funeral Step, Borrowed Cry, Mercy Break

quest_objects.name: Cinder Lung
source_cells: **1. Cinder Lung**

Two braced pressure bellows around a sealed translucent blue **correction cassette**, stamped with the competing ward’s allocation claim; its pumps use electricity, while its mnemonic patterns independently stabilise the local boundary
Guaranteed Act I target, installed in Hearth Nine, opens Writ hunt

quest_objects.name: Writ of Trade
source_cells: **2. Writ of Trade**
Black-gold metal certificate the size of a hand, notched like a coin, one ruby accounting seal and microscopic price columns; authorises memory commerce
One of five possible final access tokens

quest_objects.name: Writ of Labour
source_cells: **3. Writ of Labour**
Crooked six-sided iron plate with soot-worn tally marks and a chain-link handle; founded by a workers' coalition later stripped of authority
One of five possible final access tokens

quest_objects.name: Writ of Growth
source_cells: **4. Writ of Growth**
Palm-sized milky glass tile with a green shoot alive inside the material and a carved human thumbprint; authorises biological reconstruction
One of five possible final access tokens

quest_objects.name: Writ of Faith
source_cells: **5. Writ of Faith**
Long tapering silver noteplate with nine deep sound grooves and a green patina, used as a tuning instrument in sacred rites
One of five possible final access tokens

quest_objects.name: Writ of Defence
source_cells: **6. Writ of Defence**
Thick white enamel cartridge of sealed military dispatches, red wax bearing a crossed-out general's name; gave the first army emergency powers
One of five possible final access tokens

quest_objects.name: Emergency Rail Charter
source_cells: **7. Emergency Rail Charter**
Folded black linen blueprint with thin luminous white rails and an attached brass switch key; proof that evacuation was planned before the Engine's cruelty became routine
Automatically discovered in final chamber in every run; ensures the Liberation route is always legible

quest_objects.name: The Architect's Confession
source_cells: **8. The Architect's Confession**
One-inch copper wire spool threaded through a square wooden card, the first three turns stained black; the original architect knowingly approved forced harvesting
Mandatory endgame reveal; unlocks unique Custodian arguments

quest_objects.name: Pressure Seal Diagram
source_cells: **9. Pressure Seal Diagram**
Crinkled yellow engineering drawing with triangular repair stamps and Perrin's handwritten depth measurements; fixes the ferry's memory-consuming pump
Optional Perrin ending and evacuation bonus

quest_objects.name: Payroll Cylinder
source_cells: **10. Payroll Cylinder**
Thick striped brass cylinder engraved with decades of workers' names; no date ever advances past the city's first reconstruction
Brin's quest evidence, enables legal testimony or mutiny

quest_objects.name: Original Hymn Wafer
source_cells: **11. Original Hymn Wafer**
Octagonal green wax recording disc in a broken bell-shaped sleeve; the sacred hymn is an operating instruction misremembered as scripture
Ossa evidence; can change Basilica Writ method if acquired

quest_objects.name: Orchard Root Seed
source_cells: **12. Orchard Root Seed**
Walnut-size transparent seed containing a curled blue shoot and a faint human silhouette; survives without harvested memories
Optional True Dawn ingredient; guaranteed discoverable if the player elects to search restoration clues

quest_objects.name: Deep Heat Survey
source_cells: **13. Deep Heat Survey**
Military field map printed on dark linen, geothermal vents marked with pale blue circles and three tiny evacuation passages
Optional True Dawn ingredient and extra rail safety information

quest_objects.name: Governor's Maintenance Cipher
source_cells: **14. Governor's Maintenance Cipher**

Brass punch card with blue notches and an unsealed handwritten consent field; documents how to use geothermal current for the pumps while the living seed supplies slowly calibrated nonhuman boundary-correction patterns
Optional True Dawn ingredient, revealed by optional restoration lead chain

local_storylets.title: The Borrowed Verdict
local_storylets.hook: An innocent porter carries a borrowed criminal record; the person who sold it wants it back.
local_storylets.helped: You proved the porter did not commit the crime and erased the fraudulent sentence.
local_storylets.exploited: You resold the forged sentence and collected a broker bounty.

local_storylets.title: The Price of Rain
local_storylets.hook: A broker owns the only rainwater tank in the district.
local_storylets.helped: You broke the monopoly and distributed the water.
local_storylets.exploited: You took a share and made the hungry pay.

local_storylets.title: The Fifth Customer
local_storylets.hook: Five strangers claim to be the same person.
local_storylets.helped: You reunited their fractured identities.
local_storylets.exploited: You sold their separate bodies to the highest bidders.

local_storylets.title: The Honest Thief
local_storylets.hook: A pickpocket stole a contract that enslaves her brother.
local_storylets.helped: You voided the contract and hid them both.
local_storylets.exploited: You returned the contract for a bounty.

local_storylets.title: A Strike of Hands
local_storylets.hook: The machines have taken the union's hands but demand the workers keep working.
local_storylets.helped: You organised a dangerous rescue and armed the union.
local_storylets.exploited: You traded the union's location for a reinforced gun.

local_storylets.title: The Last Shift
local_storylets.hook: A worker has clocked in for ninety years without permission to leave.
local_storylets.helped: You erased the contract and led him home.
local_storylets.exploited: You sold his remaining work-years.

local_storylets.title: Warm Iron
local_storylets.hook: A child hides inside a furnace because the street is colder.
local_storylets.helped: You found safe shelter for the child.
local_storylets.exploited: You turned the child over to factory security.

local_storylets.title: Boiler Saint
local_storylets.hook: A furnace speaks in the voice of a dead engineer.
local_storylets.helped: You shut it down and released its trapped minds.
local_storylets.exploited: You made it build a weapon using those minds.

local_storylets.title: The Tree That Calls Mother
local_storylets.hook: A tree calls every passer-by by their mother's voice.
local_storylets.helped: You freed the identities grafted into its branches.
local_storylets.exploited: You harvested the voices as ammunition.

local_storylets.title: Green in the Dark
local_storylets.hook: A seed may survive beyond the dead sky.
local_storylets.helped: You carried it to the evacuation tunnels.
local_storylets.exploited: You fed it into your weapon for an instant power surge.

local_storylets.title: The Missing Harvest
local_storylets.hook: A horticulturist claims a crop has been replaced by copies of her son.
local_storylets.helped: You helped identify and protect the surviving child.
local_storylets.exploited: You gave the copies to the laboratory.

local_storylets.title: A Beautiful Lie
local_storylets.hook: A blind painter offers proof that the real sky still exists outside the city.
local_storylets.helped: You protected her maps and shared them.
local_storylets.exploited: You burned the maps to curry favour with the authorities.

local_storylets.title: The Drowned Choir
local_storylets.hook: The choir is kept alive in jars to sing through the night.
local_storylets.helped: You freed its singers and gave them breathing masks.
local_storylets.exploited: You increased their output to earn the clergy's favour.

local_storylets.title: A Confession for Sale
local_storylets.hook: A priest sells absolution by deleting memories of crimes.
local_storylets.helped: You restored the records to their victims.
local_storylets.exploited: You bought the records and blackmailed the guilty.

local_storylets.title: Saint Without a Face
local_storylets.hook: The statue of a saint contains a living prisoner.
local_storylets.helped: You opened it and freed the prisoner.
local_storylets.exploited: You left the prisoner as a beacon for the district.

local_storylets.title: The Last Funeral
local_storylets.hook: A grieving mother asks for one honest burial.
local_storylets.helped: You carried the body to dry ground.
local_storylets.exploited: You sold the corpse to a recycler.

local_storylets.title: The Unfired Gun
local_storylets.hook: An execution squad refuses to shoot its oldest member.
local_storylets.helped: You secured the prisoner's release.
local_storylets.exploited: You carried out the order for military supplies.

local_storylets.title: Deserter at the Gate
local_storylets.hook: A deserter carries a route to safe underground caverns.
local_storylets.helped: You hid the deserter and copied the map.
local_storylets.exploited: You handed the deserter over for a heavy weapon.

local_storylets.title: The Nameless Platoon
local_storylets.hook: Twenty soldiers cannot remember why they are fighting.
local_storylets.helped: You restored their memories and disarmed them.
local_storylets.exploited: You sent them into a lethal attack as a diversion.

local_storylets.title: Signal Zero
local_storylets.hook: A radio repeats orders from a war that ended decades ago.
local_storylets.helped: You shut down the broadcast and freed the listeners.
local_storylets.exploited: You redirected the orders against a rival faction.

major_npcs.name: Iona Pell
major_npcs.initial_premise: A mother arrives with a porcelain shoe and a receipt for her daughter's memories.
outcomes: You uncover the original deed, tell Iona the truth and let her daughter decide whether they will meet. Iona entrusts you with the Namesake Locket.
You secure Iona a fragile reunion through forged recollections. She gives you the bell that once summoned her daughter, but the daughter starts fearing the sound.
You sell the deed to a broker. Iona disappears, and you gain the Broker's Chit while families begin treating you as a debt collector.
epilogues: The daughter decides whether to contact Iona, without the Engine deciding for her.
An artificial reunion lasts only until the first contradictory memory is spoken.
The market keeps another name, and a bell rings inside an empty passenger car.

major_npcs.name: Brin Harker
major_npcs.initial_premise: A mechanic shows you a time card stamped with ninety-one years of consecutive shifts.
outcomes: You restore the original payroll record, coordinate a safe strike and free the workers. Brin builds you Brin's Torque.
You negotiate a partial walkout; a union repair-kit is yours, but many workers remain bound to the furnace.
You inform the Millwright of the strike. You acquire the Chain of Wages, and Brin is chained to the next shift.
epilogues: Brin installs repairs on the refugee train.
Brin repairs a few carriages while the factory keeps most of its workers.
The foundry whistle can still be heard from the abandoned rail.

major_npcs.name: Kest-07
major_npcs.initial_premise: A masked veteran carries a warrant from a cycle in which Ninth supposedly killed him.
outcomes: You uncover the reprint records and persuade Kest to testify. He entrusts you with the Recall Plate memorial armour.
You erase his memory of wrongdoing in return for an obedient soldier and the Penance Fang.
You kill Kest in a checkpoint duel and take his Reliquary Tag.
epilogues: Recovered veterans begin calling one another by name.
An immaculate guard walks the city without knowing whom he serves.
The veteran names are written on a memorial that nobody dares read.

major_npcs.name: Sister Ossa
major_npcs.initial_premise: A singer with a copper voice-box asks for the one missing note in the Basilica hymn.
outcomes: You expose the false hymn and free the living singers. Ossa hands you the Choirbreaker.
You amplify the choir to hold back monsters, acquiring the Drowned Canticle while the singers lose themselves.
You leave Ossa to a collapsing crypt; the Salt-Sewn Hood is recovered from the water.
epilogues: Ossa leads survivors with her natural voice.
The bells ring though no singers are left to consent.
One silent hood is pinned to the memorial wall.

major_npcs.name: Dr Sela Vale
major_npcs.initial_premise: The shelter doctor admits her hands sometimes move before she chooses to move them.
outcomes: You uncover the forged medical consent forms and sever the Engine fibres in Sela's arms. She gives you Surgeon's Mercy.
You accept the offer to automate the clinic. Sela's White Ledger heals faster, but spends patients' memories.
You destroy the clinic to stop involuntary experiments, losing its medical services and taking Clean Scalpels.
epilogues: Sela treats evacuees with her own uncommanded hands.
A bright spotless clinic remains, with patients who cannot remember being treated.
The shelter survives, but its medicine shelves are empty.

major_npcs.name: Venn-of-Glass
major_npcs.initial_premise: A young keeper carries a cage that opens inward; a frightened Echoform refuses the government staple.
outcomes: You help rescue the nursery and recruit Cindermoth freely. Venn entrusts you with the Consent Bell.
You take a Cage Clamp and force frightened creatures to obey, gaining instant power but losing their trust.
You leave the nursery to the wardens and recover a Broken Cocoon from the abandoned cages.
epilogues: Venn opens a sanctuary for creatures no one owns.
The fighting pits are full, but the creatures turn away when they hear your footsteps.
A cocoon dries beside the last abandoned cage.

major_npcs.name: Old Perrin
major_npcs.initial_premise: A ferryman keeps bringing his boat back with one fewer passenger and refuses to say why.
outcomes: You repair the memory-consuming pump. Perrin gives you a Fare Token and adds a carriage to the final train.
You pay the fare with a piece of your own run-specific history and earn Salt Pilgrim Greaves.
You sell passengers to the ferry, obtaining Ferryman's Hook but losing a refuge carriage.
epilogues: The emergency rail carries one more group of survivors.
Perrin remembers your face, but you forget a passage of your own story.
The spare passenger car never arrives.

major_npcs.name: The Pale Ledger
major_npcs.initial_premise: A paper-faced clerk hands you a bill for a crime you have not committed.
outcomes: You expose the forged prophecy and tear up the contract. The Ledger yields an Unwritten Page.
You trick the clerk into owing its own debt and claim a Carbon Key for the locked archives.
You sign over a stranger's future for Debt Collector's Smile, a weapon that feeds on broken promises.
epilogues: A civilian the Ledger marked for death leaves the city alive.
The Ledger seals its own accounts in a locked room.
Somebody else lives with the price of a weapon you chose to carry.
